Batch 6 is still blocked by environment-level DNS, not by a dead mathematical source. `node tools/source-fetch-check.mjs --coverage research/frontier-19-batch-6.coverage.json` still isolates only the unstamped `https://people.math.harvard.edu/~elkies/M155.09/jan29` row, and `--stamp --force` now reproduces `EAI_AGAIN` on all 8 batch-6 source URLs. I persisted that recheck in [frontier-19-batch-6.notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-batch-6.notes.md:620).

I did not rewrite [frontier-19-batch-6.coverage.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-batch-6.coverage.json:1). The original Jan. 29 Elkies note is still live on the web and still contains the harvested incidence-matrix, Fisher, and symmetric-design material, so replacing it now would be a false repair. The only fallback candidate already checked is `https://people.math.harvard.edu/~elkies/M155.15/notes.html`, but that is a later edition and would require a genuine re-harvest once outbound DNS works again.
